entry.name: haUrl
entry.label: Base URL of the Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123

entry.name: tokenStorage
entry.label: Where the access token lives: "wallet" (KWallet) or "config" (plain-text fallback)

entry.name: tokenFallback
entry.label: Plain-text access token, only used when KWallet is unavailable

entry.name: tokenRevision
entry.label: Bumped whenever the token in KWallet changes so the applet re-reads it

entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: Polling interval in seconds while the WebSocket is disconnected

entry.name: entities
entry.label: JSON array of selected entities: [{id, name, icon, placement}]

entry.name: scrollStep
entry.label: Brightness change per mouse wheel step, in percent
